decision_policy.promotion_meaning: Backlog selection, not implemented graduation. BLOCKING is the intended enforcement after the specified intact/red/restored runs pass independent review. No proposed check has been executed in this audit.
decision_policy.recurrence: Qualitative recurrence uses distinct failures described by the authoritative ledger and retained records. UNKNOWN counts remain UNKNOWN; BIU attribution lists are not incident counts. One incident, multiple duplicate observations, or an untested requirement alone does not establish recurring failure.
decision_policy.cheapest_layer: Reuse existing runners. Dynamic semantic assertions use python_unit_integration; artifact comparison uses evidence_consistency; discriminating mutations use mutation_gate. Static architecture_fitness cannot establish runtime reachability, behavioral preservation, or assertion sensitivity. No new layer.
decision_policy.advisory_limit: Advisory entries produce deterministic diagnostic evidence; they do not authorize operational actions or claim human receipt. Promote to blocking only after the named unresolved prerequisites and red controls are satisfied.
decision_policy.metrics: All effectiveness metrics below are prospective. Current measured cognitive savings are UNKNOWN. Measure scoped escapes and reviewer effort after implementation; do not infer savings from gate count.

candidates.deterministic_rule: For each approved obligation/guard pair, run the intact targeted assertion successfully, apply a verified semantic guard-removal or inversion, and require the named assertion to fail for the expected violation. Missing application, survivor, unrelated exception, missing assertion, or timeout does not count as a semantic kill. Restore and require success. All required pairs must qualify.
candidates.violation_fixture: An obligation with a constant assertion; a permission fixture that still fails an unrelated guard after the target guard is removed; a recorded GraphQL response unchanged when updatedAt is omitted; and a mutation whose source match applies zero times.
candidates.proven_red_method: In an isolated future test run, show each malformed battery is rejected by the battery evaluator with a specific non-discrimination/application reason. Show a corrected targeted assertion passes intact, fails on the applied violation, then passes restored. Retain source digests, application count, assertion identity and exit/output evidence; never count infrastructure errors as kills.
candidates.expected_cognitive_work_removed: Repeated reviewer guard removal, constant-assertion inspection, and manual determination that a claimed mutation kill was actually applied and reached its intended assertion.
candidates.effectiveness_metric: Required obligation pairs with qualified red evidence / required pairs (target 100%); non-discriminating covered assertions first discovered in REVIEW (target 0); reviewer minutes spent rechecking those pairs.
candidates.promotion_basis: PY-09 retained 183 green tests after validator gutting; PY-09B corrected two overdetermined tests; PY-10 found a selection-set blind spot. Ledger records specific later 13/13 and 22/22 batteries, not a general gate.
candidates.remaining_review: Humans still select semantically applicable mutations and assess obligation coverage. A timeout can expose liveness debt but cannot certify a different guard. The expired PY-04 coordinator role is not revived by reuse of mutation_gate.

candidates.deterministic_rule: For each approved composition obligation, execute its named public CLI/composition root with a valid isolated profile and real local store/adapter contracts. Require the designated operation to be reached, its success postcondition observed, and each specified failure translated to its expected typed outcome. A unit-only call or a fake store with impossible return shapes does not satisfy the obligation.
candidates.violation_fixture: Disconnect a required RetrySchedule/ReservationBook caller while domain unit tests remain green; restore the PY-06 composed exception call-shape defect; run a CLI command against a real temporary store instead of the impossible PY-07 double.
candidates.proven_red_method: Run each approved composed-path probe intact, then disconnect its caller or restore the concrete defective call shape and require the named reachability/postcondition assertion to fail. Restore and rerun. Separate profile/setup failures from the intended red assertion; no real provider or network is needed for the local integration boundary.
candidates.expected_cognitive_work_removed: Reviewers repeatedly tracing whether tested domain objects have callers, manually launching each contracted CLI operation, and discovering realistic store/call-shape failures after unit-only proof.
candidates.effectiveness_metric: Approved composed operations with both successful execution and qualified failure-path probes / approved operations (target 100%); covered composition defects reaching REVIEW (target 0).
candidates.promotion_basis: Ledger records PY-06 composed TypeError, PY-07 impossible store double, five of seven PY-08 commands failing with a real profile, and unused PY-09 substrate.
candidates.remaining_review: Probe inventory and production equivalence remain reviewed. Passing local probes cannot prove live transport or every dynamic path. Static import checks are cheaper but cannot settle this failure class.

candidates.deterministic_rule: For each explicitly named repair-path obligation, report whether an attributable harness revision and discriminating red result precede the first implementation-widening revision in the repair record. Require revision ancestry and matching obligation/path identities; missing or ambiguous ordering is UNVERIFIED, not satisfied. Do not derive widening solely from file extensions or commit timestamps.
candidates.violation_fixture: A repair record widens a named path at revision R1, while its first harness/red receipt is at descendant R2; another omits the receipt or binds it to another path.
candidates.proven_red_method: Against future in-memory evidence fixtures, require an out-of-order or missing-path diagnostic for each violation and a clean report for an ordered, attributable control. Retain those outputs. A historical sequencing gate red run is UNKNOWN.
candidates.expected_cognitive_work_removed: Coordinators repeatedly searching repair transcripts and comparing revisions just to establish whether the named proof existed before the repair widened.
candidates.effectiveness_metric: Named repair obligations with mechanically established order / named obligations; ordering defects first found manually; minutes spent reconstructing proof order.
candidates.promotion_basis: PY-08 repeatedly repaired implementation while explain/kernel and negative-control proof were missing; SWF-23 records the sixth-cycle intervention. Ledger records later PY-09 sequencing violation and PY-09B/PY-10 harness-first consumption.
candidates.remaining_review: Whether implementation widened and whether the harness is sufficient remain judgment-bound. No authoritative general receipt/order contract or gate red proof is established; keep advisory until those exist.

candidates.deterministic_rule: For each previously satisfied stable obligation in the accepted repair comparison input, require candidate-bound successful replay evidence from its preserved executable probe. Reject missing, skipped, failing or weakened proof. An exception must name the prior evidence, a resolved authorized target-changing decision, and the replacement obligation with its passing evidence. A renamed file alone is neither loss nor supersession; use stable obligation identities.
candidates.violation_fixture: Prior candidate proves A,B,C; repaired candidate drops B, reports B skipped, or has a failing B replay. Separate fixture gives B an unresolvable supersession or omits replacement evidence. Valid control changes B under an independently accepted target-change decision with replacement proof.
candidates.proven_red_method: Feed each altered comparison into the future evidence_consistency extension and require the specific lost-obligation/supersession failure; the intact and valid-supersession controls must pass. Also restore a known behavioral regression in a temporary candidate and show its preserved probe fails and the comparison refuses that result. Restore and require green.
candidates.expected_cognitive_work_removed: Reviewers manually diffing prior verdicts and test inventories to find disappearing acceptance proof, rerunning the same preserved obligations by hand, and reconstructing supersession links on every repair.
candidates.effectiveness_metric: Unsuperseded previously satisfied obligations with passing candidate-bound replay / prior obligations (target 100%); proof-loss escapes to REVIEW (target 0); manual comparison minutes per repair.
candidates.promotion_basis: PY-04 lost proof for five criteria; PY-07 introduced cancellation redispatch; PY-08 regressed AC7; the PY-09 attention repair broke its neighboring no-invocation case. Specific behavior red evidence exists, not a general comparison gate.
candidates.remaining_review: Humans establish obligation identities, authorize target changes and judge semantic weakening. The checker validates already-established authority references; it does not approve supersession or treat a green summary as replay evidence.

candidates.deterministic_rule: Using injected time and recorded observations, for a known nonterminal lane older than its configured grace, classify a launch gap only when no correlated active invocation, pending claim/effect, completed effect or unresolved judgment suppression accounts for it. Following an authorized recovery attempt, poll within its configured confirmation bound; a correlated claim before the deadline confirms recovery, while absence at the deadline reports unconfirmed. Command success alone never confirms the effect.
candidates.violation_fixture: A healthy-service snapshot has an old VERIFY lane but no verifier; a recovery command returns zero without a claim; another claim arrives after the former 25-second sample but before the configured 90-second confirmation deadline. Include pending-effect and ATTENTION_WAIT controls.
candidates.proven_red_method: Use a fake clock and scripted store observations: the missing-claim case must report a gap/unconfirmed effect; delayed claim, pending effect and suppression controls must avoid premature alarms. Mutate the classifier to trust command exit or take one early sample and require the respective assertions to fail. No service restart or recovery is executed by this audit.
candidates.expected_cognitive_work_removed: Operator/model polling of process and lane state to distinguish healthy services from absent work, and repeated investigation of premature recovery-failure alarms.
candidates.effectiveness_metric: Confirmed missing-actor detections / injected gaps; false alarms for within-bound claims (target 0); live manual liveness investigations per eligible lane after implementation.
candidates.promotion_basis: SWF-29 describes the PY-06 dropped-delivery stall; ledger records PY-08 recovery and the PY-09 fixed-sample false alarm. Canonical fenced recovery and negative-control evidence remain unestablished.
candidates.remaining_review: Use existing authorized grace/bounds as parameters, not new policy. Real latency adequacy and canonical observation/fencing integration need proof before blocking. Tests do not authorize re-emission.

candidates.deterministic_rule: Given a declared dependency and authoritative predecessor lifecycle, dependency eligibility must follow that lifecycle and declared edge. A stale Issue open/closed projection cannot override it. If the configured dependency representations disagree, return the configured explicit disagreement/refusal rather than silently dropping an edge. Test only dependency eligibility while all other admission conditions are held satisfied.
candidates.violation_fixture: A predecessor is authoritative DONE but its Issue remains open; another predecessor is nonterminal while its Issue is closed; a contract declares a predecessor omitted by the descriptor/projection. Valid control has agreeing representations and a DONE predecessor.
candidates.proven_red_method: Run the fixtures through the actual admission adapter/kernel boundary with local recorded transport and real contract parsing. Mutate eligibility to trust Issue closure or discard the missing edge; require the named dependency assertion to fail, then restore and pass. Retain intact/red/restored outputs, including the disagreement reason.
candidates.expected_cognitive_work_removed: Reviewers manually reconciling Issue closure, authoritative lifecycle and declared dependencies whenever admission blocks completed work or silently omits a predecessor.
candidates.effectiveness_metric: Dependency cases with correct authoritative eligibility or explicit disagreement / tested cases (target 100%); silent edge-loss admissions and stale-projection-only refusals (target 0).
candidates.promotion_basis: PY-06/PY-07 completed lifecycle preceded Issue closure; PY-09B lacked native edges despite declared predecessors. PY-10 retained a proven-red dependency-disagreement guard, with its representation limitation disclosed.
candidates.remaining_review: Does not select a new canonical dependency representation, create native links, or equate sandbox descriptor checks with full production projection alignment. Architecture-fitness import assertions cannot prove admission behavior.

candidates.deterministic_rule: For each already-authorized attention-worthy event, inject it through the observation boundary and require a durable correlated attention item before attempting notification, plus observable receipt by the configured test consumer. A zero notification exit without consumer receipt must remain delivery-unconfirmed. A failed channel must retain the item and record failure.
candidates.violation_fixture: Observer records DONE or FOUNDER_EXCEPTION but emits no attention item; another notifier returns zero without delivering to the test consumer; another fails after the item was durably written.
candidates.proven_red_method: In a future isolated integration test, disconnect item creation and then the consumer bridge; require the durable-item and receipt assertions respectively to fail. Restore both and require success. Test channel failure preserves pending attention. This is machine-consumer receipt, never proof of human awareness.
candidates.expected_cognitive_work_removed: Coordinators manually comparing observer logs, attention queues and callback delivery to establish whether a known event reached the activation boundary.
candidates.effectiveness_metric: Authorized injected events with durable item plus correlated test-consumer receipt / injected events; zero-exit/no-receipt cases incorrectly reported delivered (target 0); manual delivery-trace investigations.
candidates.promotion_basis: SWF-27 records observed PY-06 DONE without activation, unseen PY-07 FOUNDER_EXCEPTION and PY-08 release delay after monitoring was externalized; the PY-09 bridge later reportedly woke the resident coordinator.
candidates.remaining_review: Real harness/notification receipt and event-classification authority remain integration prerequisites. No automatic model launch, human receipt claim, or new activation policy. Red evidence for a canonical activation gate is UNKNOWN.
